messages.confirmSendCampaign: Send this campaign? Messages will start going out to all targeted contacts.
messages.confirmAbortCampaign: Abort this campaign? Messages already sent will not be recalled.
messages.confirmStopEnrollment: Stop enrolling new contacts? Already enrolled contacts will still be processed, and the campaign will complete once they are done.

tooltips.inboundEmail: Optional group email account used as SMTP. Must have SMTP + Use for Mass Email enabled. Mutually exclusive with Personal Email Account.
tooltips.emailAccount: Optional personal email account used as SMTP. Must be Active with SMTP enabled. Mutually exclusive with Group Email Account.
tooltips.storeSentEmails: When enabled, each successful send is stored as an Email record linked to the Contact.
tooltips.continuousEnrollment: When enabled, contacts added to the Target Lists or Manual Contacts after the campaign starts are automatically enrolled and emailed. The campaign stays in Sending until you stop enrollment or abort it.
tooltips.createOpportunity: When enabled, a successful send creates or reuses an open Opportunity for the Contact in the configured funnel. The same contact+funnel open Opportunity is shared with WhatsApp campaigns.
tooltips.funnel: Funnel used to find an existing open Opportunity or create a new one after a successful send.
tooltips.opportunityStage: Required open stage for newly created Opportunities. Reused Opportunities keep their current stage.
tooltips.opportunityAssignedUser: Assigned user for newly created Opportunities. Must belong to a funnel team.
tooltips.excludeCampaigns: Contacts already reached (Sent) by these email campaigns are excluded from enrollment.
tooltips.excludingTargetLists: Contacts that are members of these lists are excluded from enrollment.
tooltips.skippedCount: Addresses not sent because the domain has no valid MX/A record (would bounce).
